description: The wolf pack of Las, a map the earlier game had after Las — głębiej, set down here as a further map of this game. Its numbers are those of the earlier game's map of that name: a grid of 5 by 5 tiles with a random entrance, an air of 7 °C, a streak of 540 game minutes with six beaten wolf attacks, and a wolf attack with a chance of 0.015 a game minute once 90 game minutes have passed since the last one. Its resources are those of Las — głębiej in this game. Not carried over: the six wolves are one kind of attacker here, since an overlay gives a map one entry per kind of creature; and the healing and the wear of sticks of the earlier game, which this game does not have.
